title: CapitolAlpha: code, trade snapshot and aggregate results for "Copying Congress after disclosure"
description:
Source code, the cleaned trade snapshot and the aggregate results behind the working paper "Copying Congress after disclosure: a pre-specified event study of congressional purchases, 2020-2025". The code builds the purchase sample, matches it to CRSP returns, runs the calendar-time and event-level tests, and writes the aggregate figures.

CRSP price data are licensed through Wharton Research Data Services and are not included. A reader with CRSP access can rebuild every table with pipeline.crsp and pipeline.run_event_study. The trade snapshot is a copy of public periodic transaction reports.

Use of AI tools: I used Claude (Anthropic) to assist with writing the analysis code and the manuscript. I reviewed all code, text and results and take full responsibility for the content.
